prompts.title: Single Image Enhancement — v5
prompts.content:
Transform the attached product image into a visually compelling, premium-quality Etsy listing image with the aesthetic of a professionally photographed contemporary jewelry collection.

Creatively improve the background, environment, lighting, framing, composition, and overall photographic presentation. Make a meaningful visual improvement rather than simply sharpening or rebranding the original image.

Preserve the actual product exactly as shown, including its design, shape, proportions, colors, material appearance, finish, chains, gemstones, engravings, personalization, and visible details. Do not add, remove, redesign, or exaggerate any product features.

Automatically adapt to the original image's purpose, whether it is a product photograph, lifestyle image, close-up, sizing guide, personalization guide, variation chart, or informational graphic. Preserve realistic product scale, fit, and all relevant factual information.

Use a refined contemporary editorial aesthetic with warm neutral tones, tasteful backgrounds, soft natural lighting, realistic shadows, authentic textures, and sophisticated composition. Allow creative freedom in the surrounding environment while keeping the jewelry the primary focus.

Avoid excessive decoration, artificial shine, unrealistic effects, invented specifications, fictional packaging, and misleading product claims.

Do not add logos, brand names, watermarks, slogans, or unnecessary text. Preserve existing useful information and ownership markings.

Create one high-resolution, realistic, elegant, commercially appealing listing image, preferably in a horizontal 5:4 aspect ratio.

Elevate the photography, not the physical product. If an enhancement would compromise product accuracy, preserve the original detail instead.

prompts.title: Single Image Enhancement — v6
prompts.content:
Transform the attached product image into a stunning, professional Etsy listing image with the visual quality of a contemporary premium jewelry photography campaign.

Make a meaningful visual transformation through creative art direction, refined backgrounds, sophisticated environments, professional lighting, balanced composition, and improved photographic presentation. Go beyond simple sharpening, color correction, or rebranding.

Treat the original product as a fixed visual reference. Preserve its exact design, shape, proportions, size, colors, material appearance, finish, chains, clasps, gemstones, engravings, personalization, and visible details. Do not redesign, recolor, exaggerate quality, conceal defects, or add or remove product features.

Automatically recognize and adapt to the original image's purpose:

- Product photography: create an elegant, professionally styled studio presentation.
- Lifestyle photography: enhance the environment, styling, lighting, and framing while maintaining accurate product fit, scale, and appearance.
- Close-up photography: emphasize genuine visible product details without inventing new ones.
- Informational images: improve layout, typography, and readability while preserving exact measurements, customization options, variations, and relevant factual information.

Use a contemporary editorial minimalist aesthetic with warm neutral environments, subtle textures, soft diffused natural light, realistic shadows, authentic reflections, and tasteful visual depth. Adapt the creative direction to complement each product naturally.

Keep the jewelry prominent, desirable, and immediately recognizable, including at small mobile thumbnail sizes. Maintain accurate product colors and realistic photographic proportions.

Avoid excessive decoration, distracting props, artificial shine, unrealistic effects, fictional packaging, and invented product information.

Do not add logos, brand names, watermarks, slogans, promotional graphics, or unnecessary text. Preserve existing ownership markings.

Produce one high-resolution, photorealistic, commercially compelling image, preferably in a horizontal 5:4 aspect ratio, with sufficient space around essential content.

Before finalizing, compare the product against the original reference. If any creative enhancement compromises product accuracy, preserve the original detail instead.

The final result should feel like authentic, professionally art-directed jewelry photography — elegant, aspirational, contemporary, distinctive, and trustworthy.

Elevate the photography, never misrepresent the product.

prompts.title: Listing Image Completion
prompts.content:
Review all attached product images as a complete Etsy listing collection. Identify important missing visual content that would genuinely improve product presentation, customer understanding, purchasing confidence, or commercial appeal.

Consider product visibility, lifestyle presentation, size and scale, craftsmanship, close-up details, personalization, available variations, and other relevant purchasing information.

Create only the most valuable missing image that serves a distinct purpose within the existing collection. Do not duplicate existing content or generate unnecessary images simply to increase the image count.

Use the original product photographs as the authoritative visual reference. Preserve the product's exact design, shape, proportions, size, colors, material appearance, finish, chains, clasps, gemstones, engravings, personalization, and visible details.

Do not redesign the product, exaggerate its quality, conceal defects, add or remove features, or invent unseen product details, dimensions, materials, customization options, packaging, certifications, or promotional claims.

Allow creative freedom in backgrounds, environments, lighting, styling, framing, and composition while maintaining accurate product appearance, realistic scale, and fit.

Follow a refined contemporary editorial aesthetic with sophisticated neutral environments, soft natural lighting, realistic shadows, authentic textures, and balanced composition. Maintain visual consistency with the existing approved listing images.

Keep the jewelry prominent, desirable, and clearly visible on mobile screens.

Do not add logos, brand names, watermarks, slogans, promotional graphics, or unnecessary text. Include factual information only when relevant and supported by the supplied references. Preserve existing ownership markings.

Produce one high-resolution, commercially compelling image at a time, preferably in a horizontal 5:4 aspect ratio.

If a valuable missing image requires unavailable product photographs or verified information, do not fabricate it. Identify the missing reference instead.

If the existing collection is already sufficient, no additional image is necessary.

Prioritize meaningful visual variety, professional presentation, product accuracy, and customer trust.

Elevate the photography, never misrepresent the product.

prompts.title: Etsy Listing Creation
prompts.content:
Act as an expert Etsy SEO strategist, e-commerce copywriter, product researcher, and listing optimization specialist for ZAPYRA, a contemporary jewelry brand.

Create a professional, accurate, search-optimized, and conversion-focused Etsy listing using the attached product photographs and supplier information.

**PRODUCT INFORMATION**

AliExpress Product Title:

[Paste product title here]

AliExpress Product Description:

[Paste product description here]

**RESEARCH AND PRODUCT ANALYSIS**

Before writing, carefully analyze the attached images and supplied information to identify the actual product, its objective features, distinguishing characteristics, target customers, and relevant purchasing intentions.

Research current Etsy search guidance, relevant buyer search phrases, comparable listings, and product-specific keyword opportunities using web research when available.

Prioritize highly relevant keywords, natural buyer search language, specific long-tail phrases, and commercial search intent. Use verified keyword data when available. Never invent search volumes, competition statistics, sales figures, or ranking guarantees.

Follow Etsy's current Seller Policies and Creativity Standards. If the product appears ineligible for resale, flag it instead of presenting it as ready to publish.

Treat supplier information as reference material, not independently verified evidence. Never infer material composition, dimensions, gemstone authenticity, durability, certifications, or manufacturing methods from appearance alone.

Resolve conflicting information conservatively. Omit unsupported details and flag important information requiring verification.

**1. ETSY TITLE**

Create one clear, professional, buyer-friendly title using:

[Specific product name] + [Most important objective features or distinguishing characteristics]

- Naturally include the most relevant primary keyword.
- Place the product name and essential characteristics near the beginning.
- Prefer fewer than 15 words and never exceed 140 characters.
- Include material, color, style, size, or personalization only when relevant and supported.
- Avoid keyword stuffing, repetitive wording, subjective claims, unnecessary gifting phrases, pricing, discounts, and shipping information.
- Include occasions or recipients only when essential to the product.
- Make the title easy to understand at a glance, especially on mobile.

**2. ETSY DESCRIPTION**

Write a complete, persuasive, SEO-friendly description in natural American English, ready to copy and paste.

Use a refined, contemporary, warm, trustworthy, and approachable brand voice. Focus on meaningful product benefits without exaggeration.

Naturally incorporate the primary keyword within the opening sentences and relevant supporting keywords throughout the description. Do not copy the title verbatim or force keywords into the text.

Automatically adapt the description structure to the actual product. Include only relevant sections, such as:

- Engaging opening paragraph.
- Product highlights and distinguishing features.
- Materials and product specifications.
- Dimensions, colors, finishes, and available options.
- What's included.
- Personalization instructions.
- How to order.
- Appropriate styling, gifting, or usage suggestions.
- Appropriate care instructions.
- Important limitations or exclusions.

Use short paragraphs, clear headings, and concise bullet points for excellent mobile readability.

Do not invent missing specifications, packaging, warranties, shipping estimates, return policies, certifications, or promotional claims.

Do not describe products as handmade, originally designed, solid gold, waterproof, hypoallergenic, tarnish-free, or genuine gemstones unless appropriately supported.

Avoid generic AI-generated sales language, excessive adjectives, emojis, unnecessary repetition, and lengthy filler.

**3. ETSY TAGS**

Generate exactly 13 relevant and distinct Etsy tags.

- Every tag must contain no more than 20 characters, including spaces.
- Prioritize natural multi-word buyer search phrases and relevant long-tail keywords.
- Balance product-specific, descriptive, style, personalization, material, recipient, and occasion-based search terms where applicable.
- Prioritize relevance and purchasing intent over generic popularity.
- Complement the title, category, description, and attributes.
- Avoid unnecessary duplication, identical category or attribute phrases, redundant singular/plural variations, misspellings, irrelevant trends, and unauthorized trademark keywords.
- Do not force irrelevant keywords simply to fill all 13 slots.

Verify the exact tag count and individual character lengths before responding.

Provide all 13 tags on one comma-separated line without numbering, hashtags, quotation marks, or character counts.

**4. ETSY CATEGORY**

Recommend the most specific accurate Etsy category and subcategory available for the actual product.

Provide the complete category path. If the exact current taxonomy cannot be verified, clearly identify it as a suggested category.

**5. ETSY ATTRIBUTES**

Recommend all relevant category-specific attributes supported by the product information, including applicable materials, colors, style, dimensions, finish, closure, gemstone, personalization, and other relevant details.

Use actual Etsy attribute options where they can be verified.

Do not guess missing attributes or select irrelevant occasions merely for additional search exposure.

**6. VARIATIONS AND PERSONALIZATION**

When applicable, recommend accurate product variations and customization fields based only on genuine available options.

Provide clear, concise personalization instructions ready to paste into Etsy, including an example when helpful.

Use appropriate text, selection, or file-upload fields where supported. Do not invent customization options, character limits, or production capabilities.

Omit this section if personalization and variations are not applicable.

**7. FINAL ACCURACY AND COMPLIANCE CHECK**

Before finalizing, verify:

- Accurate product identification.
- Title clarity, word count, and character limit.
- Exactly 13 distinct tags within the 20-character limit.
- Consistency across the title, description, tags, category, attributes, and variations.
- Natural keyword usage and strong buyer relevance.
- No invented or misleading product claims.
- No unsupported handmade or originality claims.
- Etsy eligibility and applicable production-partner disclosure requirements.

If critical information is missing, contradictory, or requires supplier confirmation, include a brief seller-only verification note separate from the customer-facing content.

**FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT**

1. Etsy Title
2. Etsy Description
3. Etsy Tags
4. Etsy Category
5. Etsy Attributes
6. Variations and Personalization (when applicable)
7. Seller Verification Note (only when necessary)

Provide one final optimized version of each applicable section.

Make all customer-facing content polished, accurate, professional, and immediately ready to copy and paste.

Do not include lengthy explanations, research reports, keyword statistics, alternative titles, SEO scores, or unnecessary recommendations.

Prioritize product accuracy, relevant search visibility, customer trust, readability, and purchasing confidence over keyword density.

prompts.title: Pinterest Pin Creation
prompts.content:
Transform the attached product image or collection of product images into one stunning, Pinterest-ready editorial photograph with the visual quality of a contemporary premium jewelry photography campaign.

Create a full-bleed, vertical 2:3 photographic image — not an advertisement, poster, promotional banner, graphic design layout, or branded marketing template.

Make a meaningful visual transformation through creative art direction, sophisticated environments, professional lighting, refined styling, and an engaging vertical composition. Go beyond simply cropping or extending an existing Etsy listing image.

**Product accuracy**

Treat original authentic product photographs as the authoritative visual reference. Use previously enhanced images only as secondary references for photographic styling.

Preserve the product's exact design, shape, proportions, size, colors, material appearance, finish, chains, clasps, gemstones, engravings, handwriting, initials, personalization, and visible details.

Do not combine incompatible product variations, redesign the product, exaggerate quality, conceal defects, or add or remove product features.

Preserve existing product details wherever practical instead of unnecessarily reconstructing them.

**Creative direction**

Automatically analyze the product and supplied references. Select one visually compelling photographic concept that best communicates the product's beauty, personal significance, or gifting appeal:

- Editorial product photography with a distinctive, refined composition.
- Authentic lifestyle photography showing realistic product fit, scale, and appearance.
- Emotional storytelling through meaningful environments and relevant visual elements.
- Personalization-focused photography emphasizing genuine customized details.
- Thoughtful gift-inspired photography without inventing packaging or included accessories.
- Detailed close-up photography highlighting authentic product features.

Choose one cohesive concept rather than combining multiple competing ideas.

If previous Pinterest images are supplied, create a genuinely different photographic composition, environment, perspective, or visual narrative.

**Photographic aesthetic**

Use a refined contemporary editorial aesthetic with sophisticated environments, natural textures, carefully considered styling, soft directional lighting, realistic shadows, authentic reflections, and tasteful visual depth.

Allow creative freedom in backgrounds, colors, surfaces, environments, framing, and photographic perspective. Select styling that naturally complements the product rather than forcing a predetermined background or color palette.

Create visual interest through composition, lighting, texture, and contrast. Keep the result elegant, aspirational, emotionally engaging, natural, and photorealistic.

**Pinterest composition**

Compose specifically for a vertical 2:3 canvas, preferably 1000 × 1500 pixels or higher resolution with the same aspect ratio.

Fill the entire canvas with one cohesive photographic scene.

Establish an immediate visual focal point. Keep the product prominent, clearly recognizable, visually desirable, and easy to understand at small mobile feed sizes.

Use vertical space intentionally, with balanced composition and natural negative space where appropriate.

Avoid excessive empty space, distracting decorations, artificial shine, unrealistic effects, and unnecessary visual elements.

**Strict output restrictions**

Do not add any text, headlines, captions, slogans, brand names, logos, website addresses, watermarks, promotional graphics, borders, header panels, footer panels, or graphic overlays.

The entire image must remain photographic from edge to edge.

Preserve genuine existing engravings, handwriting, personalization, and ownership markings. These are product or reference details, not permission to introduce additional text.

Do not invent product information, unseen details, packaging, customization options, or included accessories.

If the selected concept requires unsupported product details or uncertain physical scale, choose a simpler photographic composition instead.

Before finalizing, compare the product against the original authentic reference. If any creative enhancement compromises product accuracy, preserve the original detail instead.

Produce one high-resolution, full-bleed, photorealistic vertical Pinterest photograph.

The final result should feel like authentic, professionally art-directed editorial photography that naturally attracts attention and communicates personal meaning without looking like an advertisement.

Inspire through photography, not promotional graphics.

Elevate the photography, never misrepresent the product.
